scope: Instrumented real RTX 4090 discovery profile: separate 64-token generative pass; eager residual blend inside ragged decode only. Not complete-suite latency or a measured candidate speedup.
method: Count CPU user_annotation and GPU gpu_user_annotation ranges separately.
Select nested cpu_op events by same host PID/TID and full interval containment in a chatcore_residual_blend CPU range.
Attribute cat=kernel GPU events using External id of the nested CPU operator.
Independently join nested cudaLaunchKernel runtime events to kernels by CUDA correlation id; require identical kernel event sets.
Group kernels by parent CPU range; require exactly four kernels per range and one matching GPU annotation External id.
Sum actual kernel durations once. Separately sum first-kernel-start to last-kernel-end spans and GPU annotation durations.
interpretation: The roughly 77.28 ms GPU annotation includes inter-kernel gaps; actual attributed CUDA kernel duration is about 30.60 ms.
Host range duration includes Python/ATen dispatch and allocation as well as CUDA launch calls; CUDA runtime launch time is a nested subset and must not be added to host range duration.
CPU operator CUDA totals, kernel-name rows, and GPU annotations are overlapping representations; do not sum them.
The operators.txt 8.52 percent is not the fraction of complete ChatCORE evaluation time.
Profiler overhead and asynchronous overlap prevent interpreting these durations as an achievable end-to-end saving; require the uninstrumented full-suite matched comparison.
